description: A donut chart where one slice is pulled outward with an extra outer ring to highlight it.
overview: A `PieChart` donut inside a `Card`, showing users by device. `chartData` holds one record per device with a `users` count. The `Pie` `shape` callback enlarges the slice at index `ACTIVE` and adds a thin arc outside it. Pressing a slice shows a tooltip with its name and value.
usage: Replace `chartData` with your records and keep `dataKey` and `nameKey` in step with your field names. Add one entry per slice to `chartConfig` with its label and color; change `ACTIVE` to highlight a different slice. The component takes no props.
